meta.name: prisma-postgres
meta.description: Prisma Postgres setup and operations guidance across Console, create-db CLI, Management API, and Management API SDK. Use when creating Prisma Postgres databases, working in Prisma Console, provisioning with create-db/create-pg/create-postgres, or integrating programmatic provisioning with service tokens or OAuth.

howto.when: 当你想创建 Prisma Postgres 数据库、在 Prisma Console 操作,或通过 create-db 命令/Management API(含服务令牌/OAuth)开通库时触发。
